CHANGELOG updated in BRAWLPIT: S443: real self-play -- BrawlpitPacketEnv can now queue a frozen opponent checkpoint via real MATCHMAKING_MODE_1V1; rl_train_packet.py trains every generation past the first against a frozen copy of its own immediately-prior generation, fixing the real gap where training used a completely static, undriven opponent (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
